source.title: How to draw Flowers - Adobe Illustrator Watercolor Drawing Tutorial

inferred.claim: The public source describes drawing flowers and leaves in Adobe Illustrator using real watercolor brushes.
The associated author product page describes the relevant assets as Illustrator vector watercolor brushes.
A selection of 31 vector watercolor brushes is associated with the flower/leaf tutorial family.
Exact brush definitions and operation order cannot be verified without the supplied MP4 frames.
